fact: The Ministry of Plan and Development states that technical validation of the SNDS 2026-2030 began on 30 April 2026, the last step before its official adoption.
The Ministry states that on 17 September 2025 a workshop validated the diagnostic report of the national statistical system, a key step in drawing up the SNDS 2026-2030.

A press release of the Ministry of Planning and Development describes the national statistical system as structured around the National Statistics Council, the National Statistics Development Fund and the National Statistics Development Strategy 2026-2030, aligned with the PND, so the strategy is stated in force; the date is that of the 8 June 2026 working session at which the minister presented this.
PARIS21's January 2026 NSDS status table lists a strategy as being designed or awaiting adoption: SNDS 2026-2030.
